title: COMP Method Adherence Requirement
summary: Modular architecture must strictly adhere to COMP method. All authentication, presence tracking, and UI display must use exact same functions and calls as COMP, with deviations only for modularization purposes.

title: Sidepanel Orchestration-Only Architecture
summary: Sidepanel must be minimal and orchestration-only. It should not contain business logic, only coordinate module initialization and communication.

title: File Removal Protocol
summary: Before deleting files, must verify they are not loaded by the codebase. Check all script tags, imports, and references to prevent breaking the extension.

title: Logger Removal Mandate
summary: Logger utility must be completely removed and replaced with console.log throughout the codebase. No Logger imports or calls should remain.

title: StateManager Replaces chrome.storage.local
summary: All chrome.storage.local usage must be replaced with StateManager. Use getState() and setState() functions. StateManager is the single source of truth for application state.

title: Authentication Architecture Using authManager
summary: Authentication must use authManager object (from COMP). Use window.currentUser and authManager.getCurrentUser() instead of chrome.storage.local. AuthManager, AuthModule, and realGoogleAuth work together.

title: Chrome Profile Authentication Method
summary: Use chrome.identity.getAuthToken() to obtain OAuth token, then fetch user info from Google OAuth2 UserInfo API (https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v2/userinfo). Do not use chrome.identity.getProfileUserInfo() for profile pictures.

title: Avatar Retrieval Source - StateManager.supabaseSession.user.picture
summary: Profile avatar must be retrieved from StateManager.supabaseSession.user.picture (or StateManager.supabaseUser.picture). This is the correct location where Google profile picture URL is stored after OAuth authentication.

title: No Gravatar Images Policy
summary: User explicitly does not want Gravatar images. Must use actual Google profile pictures associated with Chrome profile. Gravatar fallback is not acceptable for authenticated users.

title: No Hardcoding Policy for SD1 SD2 SD4
summary: SD1, SD2, and SD4 agents must never hardcode values unless explicitly given permission by user. All values must be dynamically retrieved from appropriate sources.

title: Agent Specializations - TA1 SD2 SD3 SD4
summary: TA1 specializes in testing modular architecture COMP compliance. SD2 fixes deviations from COMP by mimicking COMP method exactly. SD3 handles cleanup (unused files, obsolete docs). SD4 advocates for architecture. Each agent has distinct role.

title: Global Function Exposure Requirement
summary: All key functions in modules must be globally exposed via window object. Functions like window.getState, window.setState, window.currentUser, window.authManager must be available for cross-module communication.

title: Syntax Error Prevention Protocol
summary: Must proactively catch syntax errors before they break functionality. Implement syntax validation and testing. Runtime testing (TA1) should catch dynamic errors during execution.

title: Module Loading Order Critical
summary: Module loading order is critical. AuthManager must initialize before AuthModule. StateManager must be available before modules try to use getState/setState. Dependencies must load in correct sequence.

title: User Identity Isolation Requirement
summary: Prevent user data confusion. Ensure authenticated user (e.g., daveroom@gmail.com) does not see another user's data (e.g., themetalayer@gmail.com). Prioritize window.currentUser in API calls and data retrieval.

title: UI State Synchronization
summary: UI must reflect backend auth status. Sign In Required modal should only appear when user is actually not authenticated. UI state must sync with StateManager and authentication state.

title: Presence Tracking Single Source of Truth
summary: Presence tracking must use Supabase as single source of truth. Removed heartbeat-related code and UnifiedPresenceManager as deviations from COMP. Use pure Supabase Realtime approach only.

title: Database Architecture - Supabase Only
summary: Dual database writes (Prisma + Supabase) identified as anti-pattern. Removed. Use Supabase for presence and real-time. Backend services/presenceService.js should only upsert to Supabase.

title: Error Resolution Pattern Recognition
summary: User requested pattern recognition for recurring errors. When similar errors appear, identify pattern and fix all instances systematically rather than one-by-one.

title: SD2 Prevention Plan for Repeated Mistakes
summary: SD2 must always verify COMP method before implementing. Respond immediately to user feedback. Prove approaches before implementing. Avoid repeated failures on same issues (e.g., avatar retrieval).

title: Console Logging Diagnostic Strategy
summary: When debugging issues, add extensive logging. User explicitly requests 'more logging' and diagnostic code blocks when problems persist. Logs help identify timing issues and data flow problems.

title: setStateMultiple and getStateMultiple Removal
summary: setStateMultiple and getStateMultiple functions removed. Replace all calls with individual setState() and getState() calls. These functions do not exist in StateManager.

title: Background.js and Content.js Must Stay
summary: background.js and content.js must always remain in Chrome extension. They are core Chrome extension files and cannot be removed or replaced.

title: Community Membership Auto-Registration
summary: New users should be automatically registered to public communities (comm-001, comm-002). Backend communitiesController must include new users in userMemberships and set default owner/admin.

title: Auras Integration Initialization
summary: AurasIntegration must be initialized within RealtimeManager.initialize(). Error 'Auras integration not initialized' indicates missing AurasIntegration.initialize() call.

title: Chrome Extension API Availability Check
summary: Before using Chrome APIs, check if typeof chrome !== 'undefined' and chrome.identity, chrome.identity.getAuthToken are available. Handle cases where Chrome extension context is not available.

title: Database Schema Field Names
summary: Use correct field names: user_email (not author_id) in messages table. user_presence table uses is_active boolean, not kind column. Verify schema before writing queries.

title: Content Security Policy Restriction
summary: Cannot use eval() due to CSP. Diagnostic scripts must avoid unsafe-eval. Use alternative approaches for dynamic code evaluation.

title: Profile Avatar Display Issue Pattern
summary: Repeated issue: Avatar displays Gravatar identicon instead of actual Google profile picture. Root cause: Retrieving from wrong source or timing issue (StateManager not yet populated). Solution: Use StateManager.supabaseSession.user.picture after authentication completes.

title: Real-Time Subscription Management
summary: Supabase real-time subscriptions must be properly initialized and managed. Check subscriptions using window.supabaseRealtimeClient or window.supabase. Ensure proper cleanup on page navigation.

title: API Module Endpoint Redirection
summary: APIModule.js handles all API redirection logic. MetaLayerAPI class manages endpoint routing. Maintains modular architecture while providing same functionality as COMP.

title: Initialization Flag to Prevent Multiple Initializations
summary: Use StateManager flag (extension.isInitialized) to prevent multiple initializations. Check flag before initializing complete modern architecture.

title: Window Declarations for Critical Objects
summary: All critical window objects must be declared: window.getState, window.setState, window.currentUser, window.authManager, window.uiManager, window.supabase, window.supabaseRealtimeClient, etc.

title: Authentication Timing and StateManager Population
summary: Authentication must complete before StateManager is populated with supabaseUser/supabaseSession. Check timing when retrieving user data - StateManager may not be ready immediately after authentication starts.

title: Module Consolidation Strategy
summary: When modules overlap (e.g., auth-manager.js and AuthManager.js), consolidate rather than maintaining duplicates. Verify which module is actually used before removal.

title: Chrome Identity API Parameter Format
summary: chrome.identity.getProfileUserInfo now requires object parameter { accountStatus: 'ANY' } instead of direct callback, as per COMP. However, prefer getAuthToken + OAuth API for profile pictures.

title: Community Owner and Admin Filtering
summary: Frontend CommunitiesModule should filter out owner and admins fields from API responses if they cause user confusion. Display only membership-relevant data.

title: Message Persistence and Real-Time Updates
summary: Messages must persist to database and appear in real-time. Ensure both Supabase inserts and real-time subscriptions are working. Messages should display immediately after creation.

title: Domain Routing for Backend Services
summary: Backend domain routing should handle traffic to correct service. Frontend configured for specific ports/domains, but domain routing expected to handle it transparently.

title: Extension Build Version Management
summary: Use consistent version identifiers. Replace EXTENSION_BUILD references with 'v1.0' or similar. StateManager tracks extension.build as '2025-01-24-010'.

title: Error Message Context for Debugging
summary: Error messages should include context: function name, module, relevant state. Helpful format: '❌ MODULE: Error description' with relevant variable values logged.

title: Chrome Profile Picture vs OAuth Profile Picture
summary: chrome.identity.getProfileUserInfo() does not provide actual Google profile picture. Must use chrome.identity.getAuthToken() + Google OAuth2 UserInfo API to get real profile picture URL.

title: StateManager Persistence Loading
summary: StateManager.loadPersistedState() retrieves state from chrome.storage.local. If StateManager methods unavailable, use internal this.getState/this.setState, not window.getState.

title: Supabase Session vs User Object
summary: supabaseSession contains { user: {...} } structure. supabaseUser contains direct user object. Both stored in StateManager. Use appropriate one based on context (session.user.picture vs user.picture).

title: Avatar URL Assignment Timing Issue
summary: window.currentUser.avatarUrl must be assigned after StateManager is populated, not before. Check if storedUser exists and has picture property before assigning. Log extensively to diagnose timing issues.

title: Google OAuth Token Scope
summary: chrome.identity.getAuthToken() provides OAuth token for Google APIs. Token can access https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v2/userinfo endpoint to retrieve user profile including picture URL.

title: Fallback Avatar Color Configuration
summary: AVATAR_FALLBACK_COLOR constant used for user avatar background color. Can be customized. Stored in StateManager as userAvatarBgColor.

title: Extension Reload and State Persistence
summary: Extension reload should preserve state via StateManager persistence. StateManager tracks extension.reloadTimestamp and extension.isInitialized flags.

title: Diagnostic Code Block Requests
summary: When debugging fails, user requests executable console code blocks to manually diagnose issues. Provide JavaScript code that can be pasted into browser console to inspect state.

title: Module Availability Check Pattern
summary: Before using modules, check if typeof ModuleName !== 'undefined'. If not available, wait or create fallback. Use polling with setTimeout to wait for module availability.

title: Hardcoded Value Detection Pattern
summary: User explicitly identifies hardcoded values as problems (e.g., hardcoded Google avatar URL for themetalayer). All hardcoded values should be removed unless explicitly approved.

title: COMP Method Verification Before Implementation
summary: SD2 must verify exact COMP method before implementing fixes. Grep COMP file, compare function calls, ensure exact method replication. Do not assume - prove with code comparison.

title: User Frustration Signals and Immediate Response
summary: When user expresses frustration (e.g., 'WTF', 'This is fucking ridiculous'), immediately analyze logs and provide clear diagnostic path. Do not repeat same failed approach.

title: Avatar Display Issue Root Cause Analysis
summary: Avatar issue root cause: StateManager retrieval timing (getState called before StateManager populated) OR wrong source (Gravatar instead of StateManager.supabaseSession.user.picture). Verify StateManager contains correct data before using fallback.

title: Chrome Extension Manifest Permissions
summary: Chrome extension requires identity permission in manifest.json for chrome.identity.getAuthToken() and chrome.identity.getProfileUserInfo() to work. Verify permissions are present.

title: Async/Await Error Handling
summary: Syntax errors from await in non-async functions. Use promise-based approach or ensure function is async. Catch syntax errors proactively with validation.

title: Supabase Realtime Client Methods
summary: SupabaseRealtimeClient must implement setCurrentUser, joinPage, deleteMessage, editMessage methods. Create proper SupabaseRealtimeClient wrapper if methods missing.

title: Error Stack Trace Analysis
summary: Use error stack traces to identify failing modules. Trace leads to source file (e.g., UIManager.js:375 for createAuthPromptModal). Fix at source, not symptoms.

title: Notification History Manager Null Check
summary: Check if window.notificationHistory exists before calling methods. Add null checks: if (window.notificationHistory) { window.notificationHistory.addNotification(...) }.

title: Event Listener Setup Timing
summary: Event listeners must be set up after DOM is ready. Check if document.body is available before creating modals or attaching listeners. Defer if necessary.

title: Module Script Loading Order in HTML
summary: Script tag order in sidepanel.html determines module availability. Load dependencies before modules that use them. Verify all required modules are included in HTML.

title: StateManager Internal Method Usage
summary: Inside StateManager class, use this.getState() and this.setState(), not window.getState(). External calls use window.getState(). Avoid circular dependencies.

title: Profile Picture URL Format Validation
summary: Google profile picture URLs follow pattern https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/... or similar. Gravatar URLs follow pattern https://www.gravatar.com/avatar/.... Validate URL format when debugging avatar issues.

title: Authentication State Caching Issues
summary: Auth state caching can cause inconsistent authentication. Remove auth state caching in AuthModule. Simplify getCurrentUserEmail() to always check current state, not cached values.

title: Community Loading After Authentication
summary: Communities must load after authentication completes. Move communities loading after auth in sidepanel.js initialization sequence. Prevents showing wrong user's communities.

title: API Module Current User Prioritization
summary: APIModule.js must prioritize window.currentUser when making API calls. Include correct user email in requests to prevent returning wrong user's data.

title: Presence Tracking Initialization Sequence
summary: startPresenceTracking must be called after authentication completes in sidepanel.js. Ensure window.currentUser is set before starting presence tracking.

title: Database Trigger Removal
summary: SQL triggers for presence (e.g., create-presence-triggers.sql) removed as deviation from COMP. Use Supabase Realtime subscriptions instead of database triggers.

title: UnifiedPresenceManager Removal
summary: UnifiedPresenceManager.js removed as deviation from COMP. Use Supabase Realtime directly for presence tracking. Single source of truth in Supabase.

title: Heartbeat Enum and Code Removal
summary: All heartbeat-related code removed: HEARTBEAT enum entries, heartbeat intervals, heartbeat tracking. Deviation from COMP. Use Supabase Realtime for presence, no periodic heartbeats.

title: Backend Hardcoded Data Issue
summary: Backend was using hardcoded community data instead of database. Fixed by updating communitiesController to use actual database queries and include userMemberships properly.

title: Database Schema Verification Method
summary: Use SQL queries to verify schema: SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'user_presence'. \d command is psql-specific, not available in all contexts.

title: Content Security Policy and Unsafe Eval
summary: CSP prevents eval() and similar unsafe operations. Diagnostic scripts must avoid eval(). Use alternative approaches for dynamic code execution.

title: Extension Build Timestamp Tracking
summary: Extension tracks reload timestamp in StateManager as extension.reloadTimestamp. Useful for debugging initialization issues and state persistence.

title: Module Initialization Promise Handling
summary: Module initialization must return Promise or handle promise chain correctly. Check if module.initialize() returns Promise before calling .then(). Add fallback if undefined.

title: Google OAuth UserInfo API Response Structure
summary: Google OAuth2 UserInfo API returns: { email, given_name, name, picture, id }. Use picture field for avatar URL. Store in StateManager as supabaseUser.picture.

title: Chrome Identity Last Error Checking
summary: Always check chrome.runtime.lastError after chrome.identity API calls. If present, handle error appropriately. Do not proceed if lastError exists.

title: StateManager Subscriber Pattern
summary: StateManager supports subscribers for reactive updates. Use subscribe() method to listen for state changes. Useful for UI updates when state changes.

title: Profile Avatar URL Logging
summary: Log avatar URL at key points: StateManager storage, window.currentUser assignment, UI rendering. Helps diagnose where correct URL is lost or overwritten.

title: Extension Initialization Flag Management
summary: Use StateManager.setState('extension.isInitialized', true) to mark initialization complete. Check flag before re-initializing to prevent duplicate initialization.

title: Chrome Identity Interactive Auth
summary: chrome.identity.getAuthToken({ interactive: true }) prompts user for authentication if not already authenticated. Use interactive: true for initial auth, false for subsequent checks.

title: User Metadata Structure in StateManager
summary: Supabase user stored with structure: { email, name, picture, user_metadata: { full_name, avatar_url }, provider, id }. Access picture from user.picture or user.user_metadata.avatar_url.

title: Gravatar Hash Generation
summary: Gravatar URLs use MD5 hash of lowercase email: getGravatarHash(email). Do not use for authenticated users - use actual Google profile picture instead.

title: Extension Reload State Preservation
summary: On extension reload, StateManager.loadPersistedState() restores state from chrome.storage.local. Ensures continuity across reloads.

title: Module Export and Global Exposure
summary: Modules must export classes/functions AND expose them globally via window object. Example: window.authManager = authManager; window.getState = getState; etc.

title: Real-Time Subscription Error Handling
summary: Supabase real-time subscriptions can fail. Handle errors gracefully, log subscription status, and provide fallback behavior if subscriptions unavailable.

title: Chrome Extension Context Availability
summary: Chrome extension APIs only available in extension context (background, content, popup, sidepanel). Check typeof chrome !== 'undefined' before using Chrome APIs.

title: StateManager History for Debugging
summary: StateManager maintains history of state changes (maxHistorySize: 100). Useful for debugging state transitions and identifying when state was corrupted.

title: Avatar Fallback Chain
summary: Avatar retrieval priority: 1) StateManager.supabaseSession.user.picture, 2) StateManager.supabaseUser.picture, 3) realGoogleAuth.getCurrentUser().picture. Do not use Gravatar fallback for authenticated users.

title: Extension Build Version String
summary: Use consistent version format. StateManager tracks as '2025-01-24-010'. Replace EXTENSION_BUILD with 'v1.0' or similar string constant.

title: User Email Normalization
summary: Normalize user emails to lowercase for consistent comparison and Gravatar hash generation. Use email.toLowerCase() before storing or comparing.

title: Module Dependency Graph
summary: Understand module dependencies: StateManager -> AuthManager -> AuthModule -> realGoogleAuth -> Supabase. Load in dependency order to prevent undefined reference errors.

title: Chrome Storage Local Migration Complete
summary: Migration from chrome.storage.local to StateManager is complete. All code should use StateManager (getState/setState). No chrome.storage.local calls should remain.

title: Profile Picture URL Size Parameter
summary: Google profile picture URLs can include size parameter (e.g., =s96-c for 96px). Avatar URLs may have size parameters that affect image quality. Use appropriate size for UI display.

title: Extension Context vs Web Context
summary: Extension runs in multiple contexts: background (service worker), content (injected), sidepanel (extension page). Each context has different API availability. Code accordingly.

title: StateManager State Structure
summary: StateManager uses nested structure: chat, avatars, ui, sync, api, extension. Access via dot notation: getState('ui.activeCommunities') or direct: getState('activeCommunities') if flat key exists.

title: Authentication Token Expiration
summary: OAuth tokens can expire. Handle token refresh if needed. Chrome identity API handles token management, but be aware of expiration for API calls.

title: Profile Picture Caching Issues
summary: Browser may cache avatar images. If correct URL is set but wrong image displays, clear browser cache or add cache-busting parameter to URL.

title: StateManager Persistence Strategy
summary: StateManager persists critical state to chrome.storage.local on setState calls with persist flag. Load persisted state on initialization. Balance between persistence and performance.

title: Module Class vs Instance Pattern
summary: Some modules export classes (AuthManager, StateManager) requiring instantiation. Others export functions directly. Understand pattern and use appropriately: new ModuleName() vs ModuleName().

title: Extension Manifest Permissions for OAuth
summary: Chrome extension requires 'identity' permission in manifest.json for OAuth. Also needs host permissions for Google APIs if making direct fetch calls. Verify manifest permissions.

title: User Provider Field
summary: User object includes provider field: 'chrome_profile' for getProfileUserInfo, 'google' for OAuth. Use provider to determine authentication method and available data.

title: StateManager Subscriber Cleanup
summary: StateManager subscribers should be cleaned up when components unmount. Use unsubscribe() method to prevent memory leaks. Important for long-running extension.

title: Extension Version Compatibility
summary: Extension must work across Chrome versions. Test Chrome API availability and provide fallbacks for older versions. Check chrome.runtime for API availability.

title: Profile Picture URL Validity Check
summary: Before using profile picture URL, validate it's a valid URL and not null/undefined. Check URL format matches expected pattern (Google or Gravatar). Log invalid URLs for debugging.

title: Chrome Identity Account Status
summary: chrome.identity.getProfileUserInfo({ accountStatus: 'ANY' }) retrieves profile info regardless of account status. Prefer OAuth method for profile pictures, but understand accountStatus parameter.

title: StateManager Internal State vs Persisted State
summary: StateManager maintains in-memory state and persisted state (chrome.storage.local). In-memory state is faster, persisted state survives reloads. Balance between speed and persistence.

title: Extension Build Process
summary: Extension build process should maintain modular structure. Do not bundle modules into single file - maintain separate module files for modularity and debugging.

title: User ID Format Consistency
summary: User IDs can be email addresses or numeric IDs from Google (e.g., '101904640857527620819'). Store consistently and use appropriate format for API calls and database queries.

title: Profile Picture URL Parameter Encoding
summary: Profile picture URLs may contain special characters. Ensure proper URL encoding when constructing or passing URLs. Use encodeURIComponent if needed for query parameters.

title: Extension Development vs Production
summary: Extension has development and production modes. Use CONFIG module to detect environment. Different API URLs and behaviors for dev vs prod.

title: StateManager State Key Naming Convention
summary: StateManager uses consistent key naming: camelCase for flat keys, dot.notation for nested paths. Examples: 'activeCommunities' or 'ui.activeCommunities'. Follow convention consistently.

title: Chrome Extension Action API
summary: chrome.action API used for extension icon and popup. chrome.action.onClicked may not be available in all contexts. Check availability before using.

title: Extension Sidepanel API
summary: Chrome Side Panel API used for sidepanel. Ensure manifest includes side_panel permission. Sidepanel runs in extension context with access to Chrome APIs.

title: StateManager State Initialization Values
summary: StateManager.initialize() accepts initial state values. Provide sensible defaults for all state keys. Ensures consistent state even if persistence fails.

title: Extension Reload Detection
summary: Detect extension reload by checking extension.reloadTimestamp. If timestamp changed, extension was reloaded. Use to reset transient state or re-initialize modules.

title: Profile Picture Display in UI Components
summary: UI components (AvatarUtils, ProfileManager) must use window.currentUser.avatarUrl or retrieve from StateManager. Do not hardcode avatar URLs in UI components.

title: Chrome Identity API Promise Wrapper
summary: Chrome identity API uses callbacks. Wrap in Promise for async/await usage. Pattern: new Promise((resolve, reject) => { chrome.identity.method(params, (result) => { ... }); }).

title: StateManager State Update Notifications
summary: StateManager can notify subscribers of state changes. Use for reactive UI updates. Subscribe to specific keys or all changes. Unsubscribe when component unmounts.

title: Extension Background Service Worker
summary: Background script runs as service worker in Manifest V3. Has limited lifecycle. Use chrome.storage for persistence. Initialize properly on startup.

title: Profile Picture URL Fetch Error Handling
summary: If Google OAuth API fetch fails, handle error gracefully. Log error details. May fall back to cached picture or show default, but avoid Gravatar for authenticated users.

title: StateManager State Path Resolution
summary: StateManager resolves nested paths: 'ui.activeCommunities' accesses state.ui.activeCommunities. Supports both flat and nested access patterns.

title: Extension Content Script Injection
summary: Content scripts inject into web pages. Limited access to extension APIs. Use message passing for communication with background or sidepanel.

title: Chrome Extension Message Passing
summary: Use chrome.runtime.sendMessage and chrome.runtime.onMessage for communication between extension contexts. Proper message format and error handling important.

title: StateManager State Validation
summary: StateManager should validate state values before storing. Sanitize user input, validate types, ensure required fields present. Prevents state corruption.

title: Profile Picture URL Size Optimization
summary: Google profile picture URLs support size parameters. Use appropriate size for UI (e.g., =s96-c for small avatars, =s200 for larger). Balance quality and performance.

title: Extension Storage Quota Management
summary: Chrome storage has quota limits. StateManager should prioritize critical state for persistence. Avoid storing large objects or excessive history.

title: StateManager State Reset Capability
summary: StateManager.resetState() allows resetting state to defaults. Useful for logout, error recovery, or testing. Supports resetting specific paths or entire state.

title: Chrome Extension Update Detection
summary: Detect extension updates using chrome.runtime.onInstalled with reason 'update'. Re-initialize or migrate state if needed on update.

title: Profile Picture URL HTTPS Requirement
summary: Profile picture URLs must use HTTPS. Chrome extension CSP may block HTTP images. Ensure all avatar URLs use HTTPS protocol.

title: StateManager State Migration
summary: When state structure changes, migrate old state format to new format. StateManager should handle version differences and migrate automatically on load.

title: Extension Manifest V3 Migration
summary: Extension uses Manifest V3. Background scripts are service workers. No persistent background pages. Use chrome.storage for persistence, chrome.alarms for periodic tasks.

title: Profile Picture URL Cross-Origin Issues
summary: Profile picture URLs from Google may have CORS restrictions. Chrome extension context may bypass some restrictions, but be aware of cross-origin image loading.

title: StateManager State Snapshot
summary: StateManager can create snapshots of current state for debugging or recovery. Export state as JSON for analysis or backup.

title: Extension Permission Model
summary: Extension permissions declared in manifest.json. User grants permissions on install. Check permission availability before using restricted APIs.

title: Profile Picture URL Expiration
summary: Google profile picture URLs may expire or change. Store URL but be prepared to refresh if image fails to load. Consider caching with expiration.

title: StateManager State Compression
summary: For large state objects, consider compression before persisting to chrome.storage. Balance between storage usage and performance overhead.

title: Extension Install Flow
summary: On extension install, chrome.runtime.onInstalled fires with reason 'install'. Initialize state, request permissions, set up initial configuration.

title: Profile Picture URL CDN Optimization
summary: Google uses CDN for profile pictures. URLs may redirect or use different CDN endpoints. Handle redirects and ensure correct final URL is stored.

title: StateManager State Deduplication
summary: StateManager should avoid storing duplicate data. Use references or IDs instead of full objects when possible. Reduces storage usage and improves performance.

title: Extension Uninstall Cleanup
summary: On extension uninstall, chrome.storage.local may persist. Consider cleanup strategy if needed. Extension cannot run cleanup code after uninstall.

title: Profile Picture URL Parameter Persistence
summary: When storing profile picture URLs, preserve size parameters and other URL parameters. Do not strip parameters that affect image quality or format.

title: StateManager State Atomic Updates
summary: StateManager should support atomic updates for multiple state keys. Use setStateMultiple (if re-implemented) or batch updates to prevent intermediate inconsistent state.

title: Extension Context Isolation
summary: Extension contexts are isolated. Content scripts run in isolated world, cannot directly access page JavaScript. Use DOM messaging or injection for communication.

title: Profile Picture URL Loading Error Handling
summary: If profile picture image fails to load in UI, handle gracefully. Show placeholder or default avatar. Log error for debugging. Do not break UI rendering.

title: StateManager State Change Hooks
summary: StateManager can trigger hooks before/after state changes. Useful for validation, logging, or side effects. Implement hooks pattern if needed.

title: Extension Popup vs Sidepanel
summary: Extension can use popup (chrome.action) or sidepanel. Sidepanel is more persistent. Choose based on use case. Current extension uses sidepanel.

title: Profile Picture URL Browser Cache
summary: Browser caches profile picture images. If URL is correct but image is stale, add cache-busting parameter or use different URL size parameter to force refresh.

title: StateManager State Type Safety
summary: StateManager should validate state value types. Ensure strings are strings, objects are objects, etc. Prevents type-related bugs and state corruption.

title: Extension API Availability Matrix
summary: Different Chrome APIs available in different contexts. Background has full API access, content scripts have limited access, sidepanel has extension context access. Know limitations.

title: Profile Picture URL Format Standardization
summary: Standardize profile picture URL format across codebase. Use consistent field names (picture, avatar_url, avatarUrl). Map between formats if needed, but be consistent.

title: StateManager State Access Performance
summary: StateManager getState() should be fast for frequent access. Consider caching frequently accessed values. Balance between performance and consistency.

title: Extension DevTools Integration
summary: Extension can integrate with Chrome DevTools. Use chrome.devtools API if needed. Useful for debugging extension behavior in development.

title: Profile Picture URL Update Frequency
summary: Profile pictures may change on Google side. Consider periodic refresh of profile picture URLs. Not too frequent to avoid rate limits, but keep URLs current.

title: StateManager State Export/Import
summary: StateManager should support exporting state to JSON and importing from JSON. Useful for backup, migration, or debugging. Validate imported state structure.

title: Extension Error Reporting
summary: Extension errors should be logged and potentially reported. Use console.log for development, consider error reporting service for production. Help identify and fix issues.

title: Profile Picture URL Accessibility
summary: Profile pictures should have alt text for accessibility. Use user name or email as alt text. Ensure screen readers can identify users by avatar.

title: StateManager State Versioning
summary: StateManager should version state structure. Track version number, migrate between versions automatically. Prevents breaking changes from corrupting state.

title: Extension Native Messaging
summary: Extension can communicate with native applications via chrome.runtime.connectNative. Requires native messaging host. Not used in current extension, but available if needed.

title: Profile Picture URL Privacy Considerations
summary: Profile picture URLs may reveal user information. Ensure URLs are handled securely, not logged inappropriately, and respect user privacy. Consider URL sanitization for logs.

title: StateManager State Conflict Resolution
summary: If state conflicts occur (e.g., multiple writes), StateManager should resolve conflicts. Use last-write-wins or merge strategy based on use case.

title: Extension Offline Support
summary: Extension should handle offline scenarios gracefully. Cache critical state, queue operations, sync when online. Use chrome.storage for offline persistence.

title: Profile Picture URL Rate Limiting
summary: Google APIs may rate limit requests. Do not fetch profile pictures too frequently. Cache URLs and reuse. Respect rate limits to avoid blocking.

title: StateManager State Observability
summary: StateManager should support observability for debugging. Log state changes, track access patterns, provide debugging interface. Helps identify state-related issues.

title: Extension Update Notification
summary: Extension can notify users of updates using chrome.notifications or UI messages. Helpful for informing users of new features or breaking changes.

title: Profile Picture URL Fallback Strategy
summary: If Google profile picture unavailable, fallback strategy: 1) Cached URL, 2) Default avatar with user initial, 3) Never Gravatar for authenticated users. User preference is actual Google picture only.

title: StateManager State Persistence Frequency
summary: Balance persistence frequency. Too frequent causes performance issues, too infrequent risks data loss. Persist critical state immediately, batch less critical updates.

title: Extension Content Security Policy Configuration
summary: Extension CSP defined in manifest.json. Restricts eval, inline scripts, external resources. Configure CSP appropriately for extension functionality while maintaining security.

title: Profile Picture URL Validation Regex
summary: Validate profile picture URLs match expected patterns. Google URLs: /^https:\/\/lh3\.googleusercontent\.com\//. Gravatar URLs: /^https:\/\/www\.gravatar\.com\/avatar\//. Reject invalid formats.

title: StateManager State Garbage Collection
summary: StateManager should clean up unused state over time. Remove old history entries, clear transient data, prevent memory leaks. Important for long-running extension.

title: Extension Web Accessible Resources
summary: Extension resources can be made web-accessible via web_accessible_resources in manifest. Allows web pages to load extension assets. Configure carefully for security.

title: Profile Picture URL Loading Timeout
summary: Profile picture image loading should have timeout. If image takes too long to load, show placeholder. Prevents UI blocking on slow network or broken URLs.

title: StateManager State Rollback Capability
summary: StateManager should support rolling back to previous state if error occurs. Maintain state history, allow undo operations. Useful for error recovery and testing.
